Bundled FFmpeg binary
=====================

The FFmpeg executable is injected by GitHub Actions at FPK build time.

Version: 8.1.3 release branch, fixed build g46d899d7a0
Architecture: Linux x86_64
Source package used by the builder: BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds autobuild-2026-10-16-13-04
Build recipe and source: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/tree/autobuild-2026-10-16-13-04
Expected SHA256:
c19bd7fec94e0c56032fad4f20bf56b2847f18fbe372c758b32ed10d4dec2176 (archive)

The final .fpk contains native/bundle/bin/ffmpeg and ffprobe.
Upgraded from legacy 7.0.2 to match MeTube's upstream 8.1 HLS clip fix (#1092).
fnOS installation does not download FFmpeg.
